## Scope and maturity
Candidate/non-normative. Which RFC boundary is affected?

## Evidence
Exact SHA, commands, tests, environment, limitations. CI is not hardware evidence.

## Checklist
- [ ] No identity/Chronon/time/permission authority invented
- [ ] No device/CAN/body/network access added implicitly
- [ ] Negative and compatibility tests included
- [ ] No personal logs, secrets or instance configuration committed
- [ ] No implicit Core promotion, release, registry enrollment or robot deploy
